title: Yara and the Orchard
author: Cyrus Coldharbour
blurb: Emrys Okafor, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
